name: USD/JPY Rolling OLS Fair Value Model
description: Rolling OLS regression of USD/JPY on the US-Japan 10Y rate differential (252-day window). Computes fair value, deviation, and z-score to identify when USD/JPY is cheap or rich relative to rate fundamentals. Includes Fed and BOJ policy event markers for regime context. Dashboard: summary table of current metrics, fair value overlay chart, z-score time series, and rolling model parameters (beta sensitivity, alpha intercept).
source:
# =============================================================================
# USD/JPY ROLLING OLS FAIR VALUE MODEL
# =============================================================================
# Regresses USD/JPY on the US-Japan 10Y rate differential (252-day rolling OLS).
# Outputs: fair value, deviation in pips, z-score of residual, rolling beta/alpha.
# Event markers for Fed rate changes and BOJ structural policy shifts.
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close_fx = src.c
bar_ts = index()

# US 10Y Treasury yield (daily, no ALFRED needed)
us10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DGS10', use_alfred=False)()
us10y = ffill(us10y_raw.result)

# Japan 10Y JGB yield (monthly, forward-fill to daily)
jp10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRLTLT01JPM156N', use_alfred=False)()
jp10y = ffill(jp10y_raw.result)

# Rate differential: US 10Y minus Japan 10Y
rate_diff = us10y - jp10y

# Fed Funds Rate (daily, for event detection)
dff_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DFF', use_alfred=False)()
dff = ffill(dff_raw.result)

# BOJ policy rate (monthly, for event detection)
boj_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCB01JPM156N', use_alfred=False)()
boj_rate = ffill(boj_raw.result)

# =============================================================================
# ROLLING OLS (252-DAY WINDOW)
# =============================================================================

# linear_fit: regress close_fx (Y) on rate_diff (X), 252-day rolling window
ols = linear_fit(window=252)(x=rate_diff, y=close_fx)

rolling_alpha = ols.intercept    # Rolling intercept
rolling_beta = ols.slope         # Rolling slope (sensitivity to rate diff)
residual = ols.residual          # Residual = actual - fitted

# Fair value = alpha + beta * rate_diff
fair_value = rolling_alpha + rolling_beta * rate_diff

# =============================================================================
# Z-SCORE OF RESIDUAL (252-DAY ROLLING)
# =============================================================================

resid_mean = ma(period=252, type=MAType.sma)(residual)
resid_std = stddev(period=252)(residual)
z_score = where(is_valid(resid_std) and resid_std > 0, (residual - resid_mean) / resid_std)

# Deviation in pips (1 pip = 0.01 for JPY pairs)
deviation_pips = (close_fx - fair_value) * 100

# =============================================================================
# FED & BOJ EVENT DETECTION
# =============================================================================

# Fed events: absolute daily change in Fed Funds Rate >= 0.10pp
dff_prev = dff >> 1
dff_change = dff - dff_prev
is_fed_event = (dff_change >= 0.10) or (dff_change <= -0.10)
fed_label = where(is_fed_event, dff_change)

# BOJ structural event dates (hardcoded)
boj_ycc_intro = timestamp_scalar(value='2016-09-21')()
boj_ycc_widen = timestamp_scalar(value='2022-12-20')()
boj_ycc_raise = timestamp_scalar(value='2023-07-28')()
boj_neg_end = timestamp_scalar(value='2024-03-19')()
boj_hike_025 = timestamp_scalar(value='2024-07-31')()
boj_hike_050 = timestamp_scalar(value='2025-01-24')()

# Flag BOJ event dates
is_boj_event = (bar_ts == boj_ycc_intro.value) or (bar_ts == boj_ycc_widen.value) or (bar_ts == boj_ycc_raise.value) or (bar_ts == boj_neg_end.value) or (bar_ts == boj_hike_025.value) or (bar_ts == boj_hike_050.value)

# BOJ event description string
boj_desc = conditional_select(
    bar_ts == boj_ycc_intro.value, 'YCC Intro',
    bar_ts == boj_ycc_widen.value, 'YCC Widen',
    bar_ts == boj_ycc_raise.value, 'YCC Raise',
    bar_ts == boj_neg_end.value, 'Neg Rate End',
    bar_ts == boj_hike_025.value, 'Hike 0.25%',
    bar_ts == boj_hike_050.value, 'Hike 0.50%',
    ''
)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Fed Rate Change',
        icon=Icon.DollarSignIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Rate Change (pp)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Is Fed Event', table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(fed_label, is_fed_event)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='BOJ Policy Event',
        icon=Icon.GlobeIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Event', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Is BOJ Event', table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(boj_desc, is_boj_event)

# =============================================================================
# 1. SUMMARY TABLE — Current Snapshot
# =============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='USD/JPY Fair Value Snapshot',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Price / Model', 'Model Parameters'],
        col_headers=['USD/JPY Spot | Z-Score', 'Fair Value | Beta', 'Dev (pips) | Alpha'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Z-Score: >+2 = Rich, <-2 = Cheap'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='JPY sensitivity per 1pp rate diff change'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Summary'
)(close_fx, fair_value, deviation_pips, z_score, rolling_beta, rolling_alpha)

# Override row/col headers for second row
# Row 1 col_headers effectively reuse same positions; we use info tooltips

# =============================================================================
# 2. FAIR VALUE OVERLAY — Actual vs Model
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='USD/JPY: Actual vs Rolling OLS Fair Value',
    category='2. Fair Value',
    y_axis_label='USD/JPY',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='USD/JPY Actual', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Fair Value (OLS)', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=(close_fx, fair_value))

# =============================================================================
# 3. Z-SCORE OF DEVIATION
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Is USD/JPY Cheap or Rich vs Rate Fundamentals?',
    category='3. Z-Score',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score (Std Devs from Fair Value)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Deviation Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, title='Rich (+2σ)', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.0, title='+1σ', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Fair Value', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=-1.0, title='-1σ', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, title='Cheap (-2σ)', color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=(z_score,))

# =============================================================================
# 4. ROLLING MODEL PARAMETERS
# =============================================================================

# Rolling Beta: How many JPY does USD/JPY move per 1pp rate diff change?
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling OLS Beta: USD/JPY Sensitivity to Rate Differential',
    category='4. Model Parameters',
    y_axis_label='Beta (JPY per 1pp rate diff)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    order=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Rolling Beta (252d)', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=(rolling_beta,))

# Rolling Alpha: Base USD/JPY level implied when rate diff = 0
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling OLS Alpha: Base Level When Rate Diff = 0',
    category='4. Model Parameters',
    y_axis_label='Alpha (Intercept)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    order=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Rolling Alpha (252d)', color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=(rolling_alpha,))
